keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «장갑이 한 짝밖에 없다(문제)» 와 «잃어버린 장갑을 찾았다(해결)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (Sam has only one mitten) and the solution (Sam finds his mitten). The green sentences are the answers.

evs: When he goes home, he has only one mitten.
Sam plays in the snow with his friends.
He looks under the trees and near the snowman.
It is his mitten, and Sam is very happy!
why: «When he goes home, he has only one mitten.» 장갑이 한 짝밖에 없어서 한 손이 차가워요.
He has only one mitten, so one hand is cold.

qs.q: "At last, he sees something red in the snow." What does "At last" mean here?
qs.qko: «At last, he sees something red in the snow.» 에서 «At last» 는 무슨 뜻일까요?
evs: He looks under the trees and near the snowman.
Sam plays in the snow with his friends.
When he goes home, he has only one mitten.
It is his mitten, and Sam is very happy!
why: «He looks under the trees and near the snowman.» 여기저기 오래 찾아본 뒤에 발견했으니, «마침내» 라는 뜻이에요.
He looks under the trees and near the snowman first, so at last means after a long search.

qs.q: What is the red thing in the snow?
evs: At last, he sees something red in the snow.
It is his mitten, and Sam is very happy!
Sam plays in the snow with his friends.
The next morning, he goes back to look.
why: 눈 속에서 빨간 것을 보았고(«At last, he sees something red...»), 그것이 샘의 장갑이에요(«It is his mitten...»).
He sees something red, and it is his mitten.

ends: Sam writes his name on his mittens so he does not lose them.
샘은 장갑을 잃어버리지 않으려고 장갑에 이름을 쓴다.
Sam and his friends build a bigger snowman.
샘과 친구들은 더 큰 눈사람을 만든다.

write.src: “I think <u>Sam does not give up</u> because <u>he goes back to look</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «내 생각 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write your own idea and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because he is smiling)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because he is smiling)
